verdict.rationale: 1Password documents storing one-time passwords and accessing them on an Apple Watch, iOS/iPadOS, and desktop and mobile apps, so the tokens are clearly multi-device. However, no item explicitly documents that tokens sync automatically across phone, tablet, and computer at the same time. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of automatic cross-device sync for OTP tokens, and independent hands-on confirmation of real-time sync.

support.subject: As an everyday user, my tokens are available on my phone, tablet, and computer at the same time, kept in sync automatically
